entities.summary: Kai Curry-Lindahl was a naturalists & biologists in Stockholm (1917-05-10, Stockholm – 1990-12-05) who made significant contributions during the Modern era. Their work intersected with environmental and ecological history. Advanced biological classification and ecological understanding.
